terms.term: CPU Hardware and RAM ROM Memory (Unit 1)
terms.definition: CPU Hardware and RAM ROM Memory is a core topic in Grade 9 Information technology covering essential principles on pages 6-42.
terms.definition_amharic: ሲፒዩ (CPU)፣ ራም (RAM) እና ሮም (ROM) ሜሞሪ በ9ኛ ክፍል ኢንፎርሜሽን ቴክኖሎጂ (IT) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 6-42 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።

terms.definition: Operating Systems is a core topic in Grade 9 Information technology covering essential principles on pages 6-42.
terms.definition_amharic: ኦፐሬቲንግ ሲስተም (Operating System) በ9ኛ ክፍል ኢንፎርሜሽን ቴክኖሎጂ (IT) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 6-42 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።

terms.definition: Computer Networks and HTML is a core topic in Grade 9 Information technology covering essential principles on pages 6-42.
